Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Wed, Nov 18 7:52am to 6:03pm; Thu, Nov 19 7:53am to 6:02pm; Fri, Nov 20 7:55am to 6:01pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Wed, Nov 18 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Porteau day. The outflow is in and a touch ahead of the page: Pam Rocks read NNE 30 gusting 40 at 5am on EC and 33 on iKitesurf, and Pemberton sits 6 hPa above Vancouver, so it should hold through the morning.

Go Porteau from first light, about 8am, to 11:30. Expect 28 to 32 gusting 36 to 40, with good waves against the wind. The tide floods to 14.5ft at 1:31pm, which can flatten the swell late morning. Experienced riders, small kites.

Check before driving: Pam Rocks still N 22+ at 8am. Squamish is outflow (Spit W 12 gusting 17 at 6am), skip it. Tomorrow looks like another Porteau morning, around 25.
